DataCalcInsightTemplate.description: Explicit Feedback Reasons at Prompt Template Level
DataCalcInsightTemplate.expression: SELECT GenAIFeedbackDetail__dlm.appFeedback__c AS app_feedback__c, GenAIGatewayRequest__dlm.promptTemplateDevName__c AS prompt_template__c, GenAIFeedback__dlm.feedback__c AS feedback__c, COUNT(GenAIGatewayRequest__dlm.promptTemplateDevName__c ) AS counts__c FROM GenAIFeedbackDetail__dlm FULL OUTER JOIN GenAIFeedback__dlm ON (GenAIFeedbackDetail__dlm.parent__c = GenAIFeedback__dlm.feedbackId__c) FULL OUTER JOIN GenAIGeneration__dlm ON (GenAIFeedback__dlm.generationId__c = GenAIGeneration__dlm.generationId__c) FULL OUTER JOIN GenAIGatewayResponse__dlm ON (GenAIGeneration__dlm.generationResponseId__c = GenAIGatewayResponse__dlm.generationResponseId__c) FULL OUTER JOIN GenAIGatewayRequest__dlm ON (GenAIGatewayResponse__dlm.generationRequestId__c = GenAIGatewayRequest__dlm.gatewayRequestId__c) WHERE GenAIGatewayRequest__dlm.promptTemplateDevName__c IS NOT NULL AND GenAIFeedback__dlm.feedback__c = 'BAD' GROUP BY prompt_template__c, feedback__c, app_feedback__c
